title: Count intersecting bookings by resource
statement: Bookings are half-open [start,end). Two distinct bookings conflict only if they have the same resource and their intervals overlap for positive duration. Return the number of unordered conflicting pairs, number of bookings in at least one conflicting pair, and maximum overlap duration among conflicting pairs (zero if none). Duplicate records represent separate bookings.
constraints: 0 <= start < end; resource is nonnegative; records may be unsorted.
Use the exact declared Entry and Report record fields and solve signature. Return all three Report fields; do not mutate the caller's records.
All arithmetic fits signed int64; there are at most 30 records. Return fresh results; no I/O, tests, exceptions, panic, or static-check bypasses.

jett.signature:
namespace benchmark

struct Entry:
    start: int64
    end: int64
    resource_id: int64

struct Report:
    conflict_pairs: int64
    affected_bookings: int64
    longest_overlap: int64

function solve(view rows: list[Entry]) returns Report
